capabilities: show random messages at configurable intervals
pop up motivational messages after idle time while writing
disambiguation: Despite being billed as an assistant, it is an April Fools' joke plugin, not an AI helper.
extras: April Fools' joke plugin released April 1, 2023; the Gemmy character is animated by Rigmarole and licensed CC BY 3.0 while the code is MIT.
motivation: Released as an April Fools' plugin on April 1, 2023, parodying AI assistants by being deliberately unhelpful.
problem: There is no lighthearted joke assistant for Obsidian; this fills that niche as an April Fools' release.
summary: Novelty assistant that randomly says things and pops up to motivate you when you stop typing.
